Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: 2x2 picture-clue sprite sheet for a children's spelling game
Input image: edit target and visual style reference only.
Primary request: Replace all four pictures with the following new pictures in this EXACT order: top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right.
Top left: golfer — a friendly golfer putting a golf ball toward a hole on a sunny green; clear golf club and flag
Top right: felt — a child's hands cutting a sheet of soft colored felt fabric for a craft, surrounded by neat felt shapes
Bottom left: farmer — a farmer gathering carrots beside vegetable rows with a barn in the background
Bottom right: full — a clear glass completely full of orange juice right up to the rim, standing prominently on a kitchen table
Style/medium: retain the reference's polished, cheerful, softly shaded 3D children's storybook illustration style, expressive diverse children, bright natural colors and friendly environments.
Composition/framing: square sprite sheet, exactly four equally sized square quadrants, perfectly centered vertical and horizontal dividers. Thin straight white central gutters only. One complete independent image per quadrant. Frame every subject clearly inside its own cell for thumbnail display. Keep the sheet's exact 1254x1254 dimensions and 2x2 topology.
Constraints: change all four subjects; the new words must appear in the listed order. No extra panels or inset scenes. Do not write any target spelling words in the artwork. No captions, labels, numbers, logos or watermarks. The only allowed legible text is the short greeting Good morning! if a phrase panel is requested. For the paragraph panel use simple handwriting texture. Each clue is a distinct image matching its own description. Opaque background.
